posts.community: Asarfi Hospital Limited SME IPO (Asarfi Hospital IPO)
posts.text: Whether it is becoming a value buy or value trap! The company has planned to merge the unlisted entity, planning for main board migration and opening a medical College but despite of all these positive news it has corrected 40% from the top. Is something fishy or the weak hands are exiting, difficult to find the answer. Disc- invested 14,% of PF.
